result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverage types, limits, and certificate requirements. It preserves the existing general-provisions language and does not alter unrelated commercial terms. However, it exceeds the playbook by requiring all coverage—including workers’ compensation and occurrence-based CGL—to continue for one year after the Term, and by extending the cyber trigger to undefined “visitor data.” Those additions make the redline broader than necessary, although the drafting is otherwise clear and professional.
